blocks.text:
DELICATE SMALL GOLD WATCH FOR WOMEN
 Designed for petite wrists, the CIVO small gold watch features a vintage-inspired design with clear Arabic numerals for easy reading. Its elegant, minimalist look complements both casual and professional outfits.
Powered by a precise Japanese quartz movement and a durable battery, it ensures reliable timekeeping. The stainless steel expansion band fits comfortably without tools, while 3 ATM water resistance protects against splashes and handwashing.
Elegantly gift-boxed, this timeless gold watch makes a perfect gift for moms, wives, or businesswomen—combining everyday practicality with refined feminine style.
 GOLD WATCH SPECIFICATION
 Small Gold Watch Case Diameter (length * width): 24 * 19 mm
 Small Gold Watch Case Thickness: 8 mm
 Small Gold Watch Band Width: 6 mm
 Small Gold Watch Weight: 21 g

GOLD WATCH PACKAGE CONTENTS
 1 * CIVO Small Gold Watch
 1 * Watch Box
 1 * Gold Quartz Watch Instructions
 1 * Gold Watch Microfiber Cleaning Cloth

items.label: DAINTY SMALL GOLD WATCH
items.value: Vintage-inspired small gold watch with clear Arabic numerals for easy reading; its petite and elegant design complements both casual and professional outfits, helping stylish women express confidence and grace during daily commutes, social gatherings, and business meetings

items.label: JAPANESE QUARTZ MOVEMENT & WATER RESISTANCE
items.value: Equipped with imported Japanese quartz movement and a durable, high-quality battery for precise timekeeping, 3 ATM water resistant, suitable for handwashing, splashes, and daily wear

items.label: EXPANSION STAINLESS STEEL BAND
items.value: Features a soft and flexible stainless steel expansion band that fits comfortably around the wrist without tools; perfect for stylish women during daily commutes and social events, ideal for small wrists below 5.9 inches

items.label: THOUGHTFUL GIFT FOR WOMEN
items.value: A timeless gift choice for middle-aged women, business professionals, moms, wives, girlfriends, or yourself; elegantly packaged for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Christmas, and other special occasions

items.label: CUSTOMER SERVICE SUPPORT
items.value: CIVO values every customer experience. Each watch is crafted under strict quality control and inspected before packaging. If you have any questions or need assistance, our responsive service team will provide timely support to ensure a worry-free shopping experience

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Watch Box, Gold Quartz Watch Instructions, Gold Watch Microfiber Cleaning Cloth
